verdict.rationale: Conductor is built around running many coding agents in parallel, each in its own isolated workspace or worktree. Its API and hosted MCP server let users create workspaces and send prompts programmatically, and routines can run agents on a schedule. Together these let a user script or fan out work across many items, but the evidence shows no native bulk operation such as multi-select archive, merge, or prompt across workspaces. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-select or batch action across workspaces, a batch API endpoint, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
